items.title: SpaceX Stock Jumps Again After Lockup Rally. When’s the Next Release, What to Expect.
items.summary: SpaceX  stock was jumping again Monday—chasing its highest close for a month after snapping a four-week losing run on Friday with a 16% surge following the end of a lockup period for shares.  The Elon Musk-led satellite and artificial-intelligence company’s shares were rising 1.9% to 135.63 as investors regained appetite for the stock, which has had a torrid time since its closing high of $201.80 on June 16—reached shortly after its initial public offering on June 12.  Wall Street had widely braced for severe selling pressure on Thursday, when SpaceX’s first lockup expiration freed roughly 911 million restricted insider shares.
